title: ML-Based Anomaly and Drift-Aware Configuration-Performance Modeling for Adaptive Handover Optimization in 5G/6G Networks - Simulator + Analysis Artifacts
description:
Cached simulator outputs and processed analysis artifacts for the Master's thesis "ML-Based Anomaly and Drift-Aware Configuration-Performance Modeling for Adaptive Handover Optimization in 5G/6G Networks" (Wrocław University of Science and Technology, Department of Computer Engineering).

Contents (~1.19 GB unpacked, 308 files):

  • data/simulated/timeline_medium/ (~131 MB) - the primary 30-phase production timeline produced by the custom MATLAB micro-simulator (TR 38.901 channel, TS 38.331 A3 + RLF event loop, NR Standalone Xn intra-RAT inter-gNB handover only per ADR-14).
  • data/simulated/timeline_medium_seed42 ... seed46/ (~5x131 MB) - five seed-replicated variants for the Chapter 11 Iter A cross-seed validation experiment.
  • data/simulated/timeline_dense_urban/ (~260 MB) - dense-urban variant (3-tier hex, 37 cells, 24 UEs) for the Chapter 11 Iter B cross-scenario validation experiment.
  • data/simulated/sweep_static/ - 360-row (TTT x hysteresis x A3-offset x seed) parameter sweep used as the training matrix for the Chapter 8 surrogate.
  • data/simulated/calibration_final/ - source data for the Phase 3 KS-test calibration vs the NordicDat op1/5G-NSA/LTE_B20 segment.
  • data/processed/ (~135 MB) - every Chapter 5-11 figure, table CSV, and machine-readable acceptance summary, including all per-seed and dense_urban variant outputs.
  • data/manifest.sha256 - per-file SHA256 manifest (verify locally via make verify-cache or GNU sha256sum -c).

The MATLAB simulator source, Python analysis pipelines, hash-locked dependency lockfile, hybrid Python-only Docker image, and full reproducibility guide live in the companion code repository (see related identifiers). Three reviewer profiles (no-MATLAB, Docker, full from-scratch) are documented in docs/reproducibility.md; Profile A reviewers download this deposit and run make all-from-cache to regenerate every Chapter 5-9 + 11 figure in roughly 30 minutes without a MATLAB license.

Third-party raw datasets (NordicDat, Bangladesh) are not redistributed here - they are obtained directly from their respective IEEE DataPort entries per data/raw_public/README.md in the code repository.
